voices.note: תנו רבנן (17a.11): king, High Priest, ordinary priest
והתניא, רבי אומר (17a.15) -- the baraita cited at 17a.9
the Rabbis disputing Rebbi on wine nowadays, as the stam infers (מכלל דרבנן אסרי, 17b.1)
anonymous redactorial voice of this sugya

props.gloss_en: a king cuts his hair every day
a High Priest from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve
an ordinary priest once in thirty days
R' Abba bar Zavda: [the king's daily haircut is because] the verse says 'your eyes shall see the king in his beauty' (Isa 33:17)
Rav Shmuel bar Yitzchak: [the High Priest's weekly haircut is] since the watches are renewed
Rav Matna: unspecified naziriteship is thirty days
from where? the verse says 'he shall be [yihye] holy' (Num 6:5) -- yihye in gematria is thirty
Abaye: had it been written 'they shall not let grow locks', as you say; now that it is written 'and locks they shall not let grow long' -- let there be locks; only they must not let them grow long
[the long-haired are] like those who have drunk wine
as with those who drank wine -- at the time of entry it is forbidden, not at the time of entry it is permitted
so here too [the long-haired: only at the time of entry]
Rebbi: I say priests are forbidden to drink wine forever, but what can I do, for his remedy is his ruin
and Abaye said: like whom do priests drink wine nowadays? like Rebbi
by implication, the Rabbis forbid [priests to drink wine nowadays]
what is the reason? the Temple may speedily be rebuilt, and we need a priest fit for the service, and there is none
here [hair] it is possible that he cuts it and enters
Rami bar Abba: [walking] the distance of a mil, and any amount of sleep, dispel wine
Rav Nachman in Rabba bar Avuh's name: they taught this only of one who drank a revi'it; one who drank more than a revi'it -- all the more does the walk weary him and sleep intoxicate him
Rav Ashi: those who drank wine desecrate the service
[so] the Rabbis decreed concerning them
the long-haired do not desecrate the service
[so] the Rabbis did not decree concerning them
and these are [liable] to death: those who drank wine
and the long-haired
granted, those who drank wine -- it is written of them explicitly: 'wine and strong drink do not drink' (Lev 10:9)
Rav Chisda: this we did not learn from the Torah of Moses but from the words of tradition: 'no stranger, uncircumcised of heart and uncircumcised of flesh, shall enter My sanctuary' (Ezek 44:9)
Rav Ashi: rather, it was learned as a tradition, and Ezekiel came and supported it on a verse
here too: it was learned as a tradition, and Ezekiel came and supported it on a verse
when they learned the halakha, [they learned it] for death; for desecrating the service they did not learn it

schemas.gloss_en: אתיא פרע פרע מנזיר: here 'and locks [pera] they shall not let grow long' (Ezek 44:20), there 'he shall let the locks [pera] of the hair of his head grow' (Num 6:5); as there thirty, so here thirty

grounds.gloss_en: Rav Pappa to Abaye: ודלמא הכי קאמר רחמנא: לא לירבו כלל -- perhaps the verse means [priests] should not grow [their hair] at all, so nothing of thirty days follows

answered_by.gloss_en: had it said לא ישלחו פרע, as you say; it says ופרע לא ישלחו -- let there be locks, only not grown long (= p_abaye_pera_leihevei)

schemas.gloss_en: דכתיב: וראשם לא יגלחו ופרע לא ישלחו (Ezek 44:20), וכתיב בתריה: ויין לא ישתו כל כהן בבואם אל החצר הפנימית (44:21) -- ואיתקוש פרועי ראש לשתויי יין: מה שתויי יין במיתה, אף פרועי ראש במיתה

grounds.gloss_en: Ravina to Rav Ashi: הא, מקמי דאתא יחזקאל, מאן אמרה? -- before Ezekiel came, who said it? (a verse of Ezekiel cannot be the origin of the law)

answered_by.gloss_en: ולטעמיך -- Rav Chisda's uncircumcised priest is likewise learned 'from the words of tradition' (p_chisda_arel); אלא גמרא גמירי לה ואתא יחזקאל ואסמכה אקרא, and so here (p_ashi_arel_asmachta, p_ashi_pruei_asmachta)

schemas.gloss_en: ומינה: אי מה שתויי יין דמחלי עבודה -- אף פרועי ראש דמחלי עבודה

grounds.gloss_en: לא: כי איתקוש -- למיתה הוא דאיתקוש, אבל לאחולי עבודה לא איתקוש (a limit on the hekesh's scope; encoded as pircha -- header)

supports.gloss_en: בשלמא שתויי יין -- בהדיא כתיב בהו: יין ושכר אל תשת (Lev 10:9)
כי גמירי הלכה -- למיתה, לאחולי עבודה -- לא גמירי

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי, אפילו האידנא נמי! -- if so, [priests should cut their hair every thirty days] even nowadays

answered_by.gloss_en: דומיא דשתויי יין: מה שתויי יין בזמן ביאה הוא דאסור, שלא בזמן ביאה שרי -- אף הכא נמי (= p_dumya_shtuyei_yayin, p_shtuyei_yayin_bizman_bia, p_pruei_rosh_bizman_bia)

objections.gloss_en: והתניא, רבי אומר: כהנים אסורים לשתות יין לעולם... ואמר אביי: כמאן שתו האידנא כהני חמרא -- כרבי; מכלל דרבנן אסרי! -- the Rabbis forbid wine even nowadays, not only at the time of entry

answered_by.gloss_en: מאי טעמא: מהרה יבנה בית המקדש ובעינן כהן הראוי לעבודה וליכא; הכא אפשר דמספר ועייל (= p_mehera_yibane, p_hacha_efshar)
שתויי יין דמחלי עבודה -- גזרו בהו רבנן; פרועי ראש דלא מחלי עבודה -- לא גזרו בהו רבנן (= p_ashi_* props)

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי, שתוי יין נמי -- אפשר דגני פורתא ועייל, כדרמי בר אבא -- a wine-drinker too can sleep a little and enter

answered_by.gloss_en: לאו מי איתמר עלה: אמר רב נחמן אמר רבה בר אבוה: לא שנו אלא בששתה רביעית... (= p_lo_shanu_ela_reviit)

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי: ואלו שהן במיתה: שתויי יין ופרועי ראש -- equated for death by the hekesh, and ומינה (17b.6) the long-haired should desecrate the service as wine-drinkers do

answered_by.gloss_en: לא: כי איתקוש -- למיתה הוא דאיתקוש, אבל לאחולי עבודה לא איתקוש (see hk_pruei_rosh_machli)
